facts.fact: The document records that Lesotho adopted the ICT Policy for Lesotho in 2005, which the Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation's 2021 review (commissioned by the ministry) examined.

The document states the 2005 ICT Policy has not been implemented since its inception (citing the 2016 State of ICT in Lesotho report), and that the M&E system it envisioned within the responsible ministry was never established for lack of resources; date is the document's published date, 2024-12-30.
The document records that Lesotho adopted the Communications Policy in 2008, an integrated framework for telecommunications, broadcasting and postal sectors.
The document states the 2008 Communications Policy lacks implementation tracking guidelines; date is the document's published date, 2024-12-30.

systems.country_label: National Digital Policy 2024 (National Digital Transformation Policy)
systems.owner: Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation (MICSTI)

note: The document is itself the national digital policy (class national, no fact); facts are those it states about the earlier sector policies.
